description: Rare alBnkfNew: relocate the bank array of a bank file and patch every bank (extra table-offset argument)
Relocate a bank's percussion and instrument pointers once; only instrument 0 is patched fully, the others get the table offset
Patch a bank's percussion instrument once: only its first sound pointer gets the table offset
Patch an instrument once: add the table offset to each of its soundCount sound pointers
Patch a sound once (_bnkfPatchSound): relocate envelope, keymap and wavetable, then patch the wavetable
Patch a wavetable: add the table offset to its base and relocate its loop/book pointers for ADPCM or raw types
Oscillator depth to ratio: 1.0309929^depth by square-and-multiply (libaudio demo _depth2Cents)
Sequence player oscillator init callback (tremolo type 1 / vibrato type 128) from the free list; returns the update delta
Sequence player oscillator update callback: advance the sine phase and output tremolo volume or vibrato pitch ratio
Sequence player oscillator stop callback: put the oscillator back on the free list D_80042800
Allocate arg1 0x2C-byte oscillators as a free list and install the init/update/stop callbacks in the seqp config
Post AL_SEQP_BANK_EVT (14) with the bank to a compact sequence player's event queue
Rare sound player init: allocate sound states and events, link the free list, per-group volume table, add the player
Sound player voice handler: re-post the frame event, handle every due event, return the next delta
Stop and free a sound state's voice if it has one, return the state to the free list and drop its pending events
Post a sound player pitch event (0x10) for a state, pitch scaled by its keymap detune cents
Remove from an event queue every event whose state matches and whose type is in the mask (interrupts off)
Take a sound state from the free list, link it at the head of the active list and initialise it for bank/sound id
Unlink a sound state from the active list back to the free list, update the voice count and clear its owner handle
Return the play state of the sound state a handle points to (0 if none), read with interrupts disabled
Allocate a sound state and post its load/start event (0x4000) with volume, pan, pitch, fx mix/bus; store the handle
Post a stop event (0x400) for one sound state and clear its keep flag 0x10
Post a stop event (0x400) for every active sound whose flags contain all the given bits
Stop every active sound (flag mask 1)
Stop every active sound having flags 1 and 2 (looping / sustained sounds)
Post a sound player event of the given type and value for a sound state (no-op for a null state)
Set a sound group's volume in D_80042C58 and post a volume refresh (0x800) to the active sounds of that group
Set the audio output mode flags (1, 3 or 4 from the sound setting) and refresh the mix type of both buses
Set a bus mix type (0 = keep the current one): per-bus flags D_800428C4/D_800428C6 depending on the output mode
Post AL_SEQP_PLAY_EVT to a compact sequence player
Set the message queue a compact sequence player sends note and marker messages to (seqp +0x84)
Set a channel's notify flags (chanState +0x17) that make note on/off send messages to the player queue
Enable all channels in the mask and set every channel's fade level and target to 0xFF
Send controller 0xFC with 0 to a channel: set its fade level to 0 (muted)
Enable a channel in the mask and send controller 0xFC with 0xFF: full fade level
Fade a channel: send the fade rate (controller 0xFD) then the target level (controller 0xFF)
Send controller 0x41 to a channel: sets or clears the fx send bit 0x80 of its fx mix
Send controller 0xFC to a channel: set its fade level immediately
Post a pan control change (controller 10) for a channel of a compact sequence player
Post event 0x19: set the player-wide fx send offset and scale applied to every voice's fx mix
Post controller 92 for a channel: select its fx (aux) bus
Post event 0x1A: set a parameter of an aux bus effect (param < 8) or of its filter
Restore a compressed sequence's position from a marker (valid tracks, ticks and per-track state)
Scan a compressed sequence for marker events (0x14) and record each marker's location in markers[id - firstId]
Post AL_TRACK_END to a sequence player to end the current track
Post AL_SEQP_SEQ_EVT with the sequence to a compact sequence player
Post AL_SEQP_VOL_EVT with the volume to a compact sequence player
Post AL_SEQP_STOP_EVT to a compact sequence player
Controller 7 handler: set the channel volume and update the volume of its playing voices
Controller 10 handler: set the channel pan and update the pan of its voices
Controller 16 handler: set the channel priority
Controller 30 handler: send a marker message (value and sample position) to the player's message queue

Re-apply a channel's voice filter: amount (synth param 18) and key-tracked cutoff 440 Hz * ratio (param 19)

Controller 27 handler: set the voice clip bank (player byte +0x36) used by controller 26
Controller 26 handler: play voice clip bank * 100 + value through mp3_voice_play
Update the volume of every playing voice of a channel
Controller 0xFF handler: set the channel fade target and step size, start the fade ramp (re-posted as 0xFE)

Controller 0xFD handler: set the channel fade rate (bit 0x80 doubles the step)
Controller 0xFC handler: set the channel fade level and target at once, toggle the channel in the mask
Synth voice update param 19 (float): set the voice filter cutoff frequency
Compute 2nd-order low-pass filter coefficients (b0 b1 b2, a1 a2) for cutoff and Q at the given sample rate
Return 2^(n/12) for n semitones (negative n uses the inverse step) by square-and-multiply
Recompute an aux bus low-pass filter's 16 fixed-point coefficients from its cutoff and resonance
Return the effect of aux bus n when the main bus runs the fx pull handler, else NULL
Return the filter record (+0x40) of aux bus n when the main bus runs the fx pull handler, else NULL
Set a parameter of an aux bus effect (wrapper of the effect param handler)
Set an aux filter parameter (8 = cutoff in tenths, 9 = resonance) and recompute its coefficients
Synth voice update AL_FILTER_SET_PAN: set a voice's pan (the real pan, unlike the custom n_alSynSetPan)
Synth voice update of custom param type 17 with a byte value (sound player event 0x8000, controller 35)
Post a MIDI event (status, byte1, byte2) to a compact sequence player after the given delta
